reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation follows the Latin closely throughout: tenses are preserved (exaudiet/escutará, invocabo/invocarei, placebo/agradarei; miseretur/tem piedade), the Septuagintal readings (pericula inferni, in diebus meis invocabo, custodiens parvulos, in regione vivorum) are kept rather than smoothed toward the Hebrew, and the only liberties are the permitted ones (copula in 'o Senhor é misericordioso', the participle 'custodiens' rendered as the finite 'guarda' in a verbless clause, named subject 'ele' in 6). Pointing marks match the Latin in every verse, including the ‡ … * sequence in 4b and 8."}
